_note: Product archetypes anchored on published Bangladeshi offers. Terms are taken from the cited source as reported on its date; they are not live quotes and imply no partnership. null means the source didn't state it. Win plan CORE-14.

archetypes.label: Small mobile-wallet loan
archetypes.anchored_on: City Bank and bKash Digital Nano Loan
archetypes.terms_note: Limit raised to Tk 50,000 and tenure to six months (June 2025 report); 9% a year per the launch coverage.

archetypes.label: Mobile-wallet Pay Later
archetypes.anchored_on: City Bank and bKash Pay Later
archetypes.terms_note: Free if repaid within 7 days; otherwise it becomes a three-month loan at 9% a year. For purchases at wallet merchants.

archetypes.label: Bank loan from the government small-business fund
archetypes.anchored_on: Bangladesh Bank Tk 5,000 crore revolving CMSME working-capital refinance fund
archetypes.terms_note: Banks may charge end borrowers at most 9%; revolving fund with a three-year tenure and a 3–6 month grace period; borrowers with a bad record at the Bangladesh Bank credit bureau (CIB) cannot get it. Processing time is not stated in the source; 21 days is LaMP's assumption for a bank loan.

archetypes.label: Bank small-business loan, no collateral
archetypes.terms_note: Promotional rate 'as low as 13.75%' for August and September 2025. Processing time is not stated in the source; 14 days is LaMP's assumption.

archetypes.label: Microfinance business loan
archetypes.terms_note: Source: microfinance institutions charge 'upwards of 20 per cent'; 20% is the lower bound. Membership and weekly instalments are typical.

archetypes.label: Credit from an online wholesale app
archetypes.terms_note: Credit for retailers buying through the platform; pricing isn't published, so LaMP can't compare its cost.
